title: Hollingsworth's 28-point eruption seals back-to-back crown for Petrolina AEK
description: Petrolina AEK successfully defended their ECOMMBX Basket League championship on Monday, holding off a furious late rally from Keravnos Strovolou to win 68-64 in Game 5 of the finals at the Kition Arena and claim the title 3-2 in front of approximately 4,000 fans. Taveion Hollingsworth (188-G-1999, college: WKU) was the driving force with a game-high 28 points, including a clutch fourth-quarter performance that kept AEK ahead when Keravnos closed within a single point in the dying seconds. Jayveous McKinnis (201-F-1999, college: Ole Miss) added 16 points and Ta'Lon Cooper (193-G-1999, college: S.Carolina) had 12, including the composed free throws and a Reed Nottage (198-G, college: CBU) dunk in the closing seconds that sealed the championship for coach Christoforos Liavadiotis' side.
